description: This file defines the TaskFormPage class, a Flutter widget used for creating or editing tasks. It includes UI components such as text fields, dropdowns, date pickers, and tags related to task details like title, description, priority, status, project, due date, and tags. It also manages form validation, state, and interactions with repositories for persisting task data.

classes.name: TaskFormPage
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a form for creating or editing a task, with associated state management and form handling.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, populating fields if editing an existing task.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text editing controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _pickDueDateTime
methods.description: Displays date and time pickers for setting the task's due date and time.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Validates and saves the task data using the task repository, handles UI updates and errors.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes the current task via the repository and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI, including form fields, pickers, and action buttons.
